result:
The default changed from the temporary CIEL medication-dispense concept set to a single status concept, and the source type changed from `Concept set` to `Answer to`. The change was commit `6e8da1b1b5a459933ca78eaabf87713592f5ab61` (PR #3412, "(fix) Update Default Procedure Status Concept"), and its ticket is O3-5652.

- **Before:** the original commit `6797e139` (PR #3320, O3-5077) set `statusConceptUuid` to `167157AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA` with source type `Concept set`. A TODO above it said the procedure-status concept set wasn't available yet, so it pointed at CIEL concept 167157 (Medication dispense status).
- **After:** PR #3412 switched the default to `f0d47b45-8303-4cdc-a9f2-c37135a3700f` with source type `Answer to`. Its description says this is the newly published Procedure Status Concept, CIEL 170800.
- **Where it is used:** the form reads the status options through `useConceptSearch` with these config values.

The README at `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-procedures-app/README.md` (lines 51–52, from the original commit) still documents the old `167157AAAA…` / `Concept set` default. I did not re-read it at HEAD, so I'm not citing it as evidence.
